mapper.select: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER = 'TI_COP'
SELECT INDEX_NAME, COLUMN_NAME FROM ALL_IND_COLUMNS WHERE INDEX_OWNER = 'TI_COP' AND TABLE_NAME = #{tableName}

SELECT atc.column_name as column_name, CASE WHEN atc.data_type IN ('CHAR','NCHAR','VARCHAR2','NVARCHAR2') THEN atc.data_type || '(' || atc.char_length || ')' WHEN atc.data_type IN ('NUMBER') AND atc.data_precision IS NOT NULL THEN atc.data_type || '(' || atc.data_precision || NVL2(atc.data_scale, ','||atc.data_scale, '') || ')' WHEN atc.data_type IN ('FLOAT') AND atc.data_precision IS NOT NULL THEN atc.data_type || '(' || atc.data_precision || ')' ELSE atc.data_type END AS colume_type FROM all_tab_columns atc WHERE atc.owner = 'TI_COP' AND atc.table_name = #{tableName} ORDER BY atc.table_name, atc.column_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROMPT_HISTORY (UUID, PROMPT_TEXT, RESPONSE_TEXT, MODEL_NAME, CALL_DATE, CALL_TIME, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{prompt_text,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{response_text,jdbcType=CLOB}, 'GPT-4o', #{call_date}, #{call_time}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT UUID as uuid, PROMPT_TEXT as promptText, RESPONSE_TEXT as responseText, MODEL_NAME as modelName, CALL_DATE as callDate, CALL_TIME as callTime, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt FROM PROMPT_HISTORY ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
